subject: Air freight quote: MUC to YYZ
body:
Hi there,

Hope your week’s going well! I’m arranging the flight from Germany for our buyer’s import into Toronto, Canada. Could you send me an all-in price in EUR for the cheapest air freight option from MUC to YYZ?

The import shipment consists of 5 pieces of automotive sensors, with a gross weight of 3258.44 lb and a total volume of 306.18 cubic feet. The goods will be ready on 2026-11-25, and we’ll deliver them to MUC ourselves, so there’s no need to arrange pickup.

Thanks for having a look!

Please include cargo insurance in the all-in price, on the terms of our frame agreement: goods value 90000 EUR, insured at 110 % of that value, premium rate 0.45 %.

Cheers,
Klaus Weidner
Weidner Spielwaren GmbH, Nuremberg

classification.reasoning: The customer is requesting an all-in air freight price for a specific shipment, so this is a new quote request.
